| # bds_out_aov {#bds_out_aov-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Sets the analog voltage output to a given set point.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- The analog voltage has two output types namely PWM and AOV.

oThe set point range of the PWM is 25 to 75% of the battery voltage (available signal refer to table \"PVG Proportional Voltage Output\" in).

oThe set point range of the AOV is 0 to 10000mV (available signal refer to table \"AOV Analog Voltage Output\" in).

oIf the set point has been set to 0 value then the output can also be used as analog voltage input. (see [bds_out_aov_getVoltage)](bds_out_aov_getvoltage.html){.topiclink}

- For more information see [bds_out_aov_getStatus](bds_out_aov_getstatus.html){.topiclink} and [bds_out_aov_resetError](bds_out_aov_reseterror.html){.topiclink}.

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   For the output type PWM an external load is mandatory, see Technical Data Sheet (RE-sheet RE95207).
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
